rubric.evidence: WebIDL verified verbatim from WHATWG WebHID Living Standard and Blink hid.idl/hid_device.idl/navigator_hid.idl/worker_navigator_hid.idl; Android 17 (API level 37) requirement, WebView exclusion, and six enterprise policies verified from ChromeStatus 5172464636133376, blink-dev Intent to Ship, and Chromium hid_service_android.cc.

Feature 5172464636133376 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=158 with listing name 'Support for WebHID'; slug support-for-webhid matches lib/chromestatus.ts slugify(); H1 equals listing name; chromestatus.com/feature/5172464636133376 declared in .doc-table ChromeStatus row.

reference-contract.json maps 4 source-derived inventory items (navigator.hid/HID enumeration, HIDDevice lifecycle & I/O, events & report descriptors, and Chrome 158 Android 17+ platform/policy contract) across all 9 dimensions with verified selectors.

Clearly explains what changes in Chrome 158 (Android 17+ rollout without IDL changes), why Android WebView is excluded, and documents every method, filter constraint, error path, and enterprise policy.

Two complete semantic <pre><code> examples covering feature detection, getDevices/requestDevice/open/inputreport/sendReport/receiveFeatureReport, and descriptor inspection + forget(). No chrome-platform-showcase demo exists yet (HEAD returned 404 on 2026-11-24).

Honest Limited availability banner matching webstatus.dev; compatibility table combines BCD desktop Chrome/Edge 89, Mozilla Negative (#459), WebKit Oppose (#510), ChromeStatus 158 Android 17+, explicit WebView unsupported note, and candid note that BCD still lists chrome_android: false.

Every visible source label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; full 16-digit ChromeStatus ID 5172464636133376; all primary spec, Blink, Chrome Enterprise, BCD, webstatus.dev, and WPT URLs verified on 2026-11-24.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, keyboard-focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with role='region' aria-labelledby and :focus-visible outline, <nav class='local-nav'> with aria-label, Baseline banner role='note'.

Uses upgraded shared public/styles.css layout with logical max-inline-size: 100% .table-wrap horizontal scrollers, .lede before .baseline-banner, wrapping .local-nav and .baseline-browsers, and zero redundant inline overrides.
HEAD check on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v158/support-for-webhid/ returned 404 on 2026-11-24; no broken iframe or speculative showcase link emitted.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible navigation landmarks skip links focus management
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), maintain sequential heading hierarchy (h1-h3), use semantic <table> with <caption> and <th scope>, and provide visible :focus-visible outlines on keyboard-focusable scroll containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, and tabindex='0' role='region' aria-labelledby on wide .table-wrap regions with 3px :focus-visible outline.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation layout tables code blocks mobile desktop
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size: 100%), overflow: auto scroll containers for wide data tables and code blocks, and flex-wrap with gap rather than overflow: hidden clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap constrains width via max-inline-size: 100% with min-width on .compat-table and .scroll-table; relies on shared public/styles.css flex-wrap and overflow-x: auto rules without inline pre/h1/code overrides.

guidanceConsulted.query: typography code blocks dark mode reference docs
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic light-dark() design tokens from the shared stylesheet so typography, tables, and code blocks adapt cleanly to light and dark color schemes without hardcoded colors.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: uses shared /public/styles.css semantic CSS variables exclusively (no hardcoded colors or inline overrides of pre, code, h1, or blockquote).
